ownerStatement: 使用者於 2026-09-20 先回答『是我本人』，針對分享、存取者及備份控制補充『我控制 沒有人知道』。依使用者陳述確認本人控制；不是對所有歷史提出無法證明的保證。
sharingHistory: Owner states nobody else knows or has access; no sharing reported
backupCustody: Owner states under their control; backup medium unspecified and not required to disclose
scope: owner custody statement plus bounded available Git/source archive audit; no known compromise, not proof of all historic events
